user.title: Add a zone
user.description: Learns how fast this zone heats up from its history and tells you how many minutes of heating it needs to reach the target.

data_description.zone_name: Name of the zone (room or heating zone); also used for the entity IDs.
data_description.climate_entity: Climate entity of the zone. Uses current_temperature, hvac_action, temperature (target) and the HVAC mode.
data_description.room_temperature_sensor: Optional. Replaces the thermostat's current_temperature (e.g. a sensor away from the radiator).
data_description.heating_effort_sensor: Optional. Heating demand in % (0-100), e.g. valve opening. Without it the effort comes from hvac_action (heating = 100 %, idle/off = 0 %).
data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor: Optional. Current outdoor temperature (history is used for learning).
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Forecast for the preheat window (hourly, else twice daily, else daily) and outdoor temperature when no outdoor sensor is set.
data_description.arrival_sensor: Optional. Timestamp sensor with the expected arrival (e.g. sensor.house_next_return_eta from Home Return Predictor): enables the preheat start and preheat now entities.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A schedule helper (e.g. schedule.living_room_heating). The start of its next block that raises the target is used as the arrival, so preheat start and preheat now work without an arrival sensor. The sooner of the two wins when both are set.
data_description.schedule_target_key: Name of the data field of each schedule block that holds the target temperature (default: target_temperature). Only used with a schedule.
data_description.target_mode: Use a fixed target or follow the thermostat's set temperature.
data_description.target_temperature: Target used in fixed mode (also the fallback when the thermostat has no set temperature).

reconfigure.description: Thermostat: {climate}. Remove and add the zone again to use another thermostat.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already used by a zone.

data_description.target_mode: Use a fixed target or follow the thermostat's set temperature.
data_description.target_temperature: Target used in fixed mode (also the fallback when the thermostat has no set temperature).
data_description.half_life_days: Older data weighs half after this many days (adapts to seasons).
data_description.history_days: Days of recorder history loaded on first start and by the retrain action.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often the estimate is recomputed, in minutes.
data_description.allow_untrusted: Publish preheat minutes even when the fit looks unreliable (a parameter at its limit, too little heating data, no skill over persistence). Off by default: the estimate is then unknown with reason untrusted_fit.
data_description.zone_group: Optional. Zones on the same boiler zone (e.g. upstairs) share the heating and loss rates of their well fitted peers while their own fit is immature. Leave empty to learn every zone on its own.
data_description.self_calibrate: Scale the preheat estimate by how the previous warm-ups turned out (needs several clean scored runs; stays at 1.0 until then).
